mentions.name: std_slop
mentions.description: A SQLite-centric coding agent that takes a different approach: all context is managed in SQLite, and a "mail model" uses the git email workflow as the agentic plan → code → review loop, with patches guaranteed bisect-safe. Instead of free-form read/write/patch tools, everything runs in a JavaScript control plane via a REPL, and JS functions can be persisted in the database for future use specific to the codebase.
